_note: Hindi headings for the Compilation of Fundamental Rules and Supplementary Rules, written in this session. heading.en is blank for all 77 rules in data/rules/text/fr-sr.json — DoPT's Hindi issue of this compilation is a 296-page scan with no extractable text layer at all (docs/DATA-GAPS.md #45) — so every heading here is authored from the rule's own text.en, not translated from an English heading that does not exist. Terminology follows the Department of Official Language's प्रशासनिक शब्दावली and reuses the pay-fixation vocabulary this app already established in data/pay/*.json and src/i18n/hi.json's pay.* block — वेतन निर्धारण, वेतनवृद्धि, प्रतिनियुक्ति, स्थानांतरण, अधिवर्षिता, उपदान — rather than inventing new terms. Several FR numbers bundle more than one historical sub-rule under one OCR'd block (e.g. F.R. 12, 14, 17, 22, 31); the heading follows the block's substantive rule, not every clause fused into it. Every card built on these carries verify: true.
